description: Authoritative architecture specification. All development decisions must comply. When in doubt, check here first.

enrichment_runtime.principle: All third-party API calls go through n8n workflows. Python scripts are batch orchestrators only — they query Supabase for vendor lists and POST to n8n webhooks. Python must never call RapidAPI, Apify, LinkedIn, or any enrichment API directly.
enrichment_runtime.violation_example: A Python script that imports requests and calls g2-data-api.p.rapidapi.com directly is an architectural violation.
enrichment_runtime.correct_pattern: Python reads vendors from Supabase, POSTs {vendors, rapidapi_key, admin_url} to N8N_<PIPELINE>_WEBHOOK, reads response.

n8n_webhooks.description: All n8n webhook URLs are stored as env vars. Set after deploying each workflow to n8n Cloud.

llm.primary_rationale: Cost-optimised: ~$0.15/1M input tokens. Sufficient quality for structured vendor extraction.
llm.fallback_rationale: Free local fallback when OpenAI is unavailable or rate-limited.
llm.note: Mistral local gives poor quality for specific vendor knowledge — use only as emergency fallback, never primary.

rag.design_intent: Crawl vendor site -> store page chunks in vendor_pages -> embed with nomic-embed-text -> store vectors in vendor_page_embeddings -> use vector similarity to retrieve relevant chunks per LLM question group.
rag.retrieval: cosine similarity, top-k chunks per question group
rag.status: designed and partially coded, not yet wired into active pipeline — must be completed
rag.why_it_matters: Without RAG, LLM gets first N chunks regardless of relevance. With RAG, each question group gets the most semantically relevant page content.

tiers.name: Direct HTTP
tiers.escalate_when: word_count < 200 OR vendor name missing/looks like tagline

crawl_strategy.principle: Always try cheapest tier first. Escalate only on failure signal.

data_model.public_serving: Exported JSON at docs/website/data/directory_dataset.json — frontend reads this, never Supabase directly
data_model.write_rule: Upsert by normalised domain. Never overwrite existing non-null values (safe-upsert). Higher-confidence values may overwrite lower-confidence ones.

field_taxonomy.scraped_*: Deterministic HTML extraction — rule-based, never LLM
field_taxonomy.no_prefix: Operator-set or final merged fields — never auto-overwritten

directory_export.trigger: Run after any enrichment cycle to update live directory

admin.principle: Admin API is the write-back endpoint for n8n workflows. n8n POSTs enrichment results to /admin/ops/store-crawl-result.

frontend.principle: No direct Supabase calls from browser. All data served from exported JSON.

guardrails: Python enrichment scripts must not call third-party APIs directly — use n8n webhooks
LLM primary must be gpt-4o-mini, not gpt-4o or local Mistral
Mistral local is fallback only — never primary — quality is insufficient for vendor data
RAG must be wired: crawl -> embed -> vector store -> retrieve per question group -> LLM
Safe-upsert: never overwrite existing non-null values in cs_vendors
Frontend must never read from Supabase directly
Export must be re-run after every enrichment cycle
All architectural decisions must be reflected in this file before implementation
